decisions.reason: As a handle family in the firm's core architectural-hardware range that has already remained in the portfolio for two cycles, sunk development and portfolio-commitment effects make withdrawal unlikely absent clear failure.

This mitred handle family supports the firm's design-led positioning and one-stop specification logic, so management would tend to justify the launch and continue carrying it rather than reverse course.

The multifunctional handle is closely tied to the firm's barrier-free and system-solution direction, which raises strategic commitment and favors retention unless performance problems become unmistakable.
Another lever-handle family in the firm's established competence area benefits from prior engineering, tooling and market-introduction investment, making continued support the more likely choice.
The door and window handle collection has the strongest public commitment through its dedicated presentation and design-award signal, so taking it off the market within a year is highly unlikely.
